Source of truth is the two registry homes (.claude/epr-meta/policies.yaml + .claude/epr-meta/concerns.yaml); this is their published projection for external peer runtimes. Tips only: a superseded row never appears here, and its lineage lives in concern-canon-changelog.json. Regenerate with `python3 .claude/scripts/_lib/concern_canon_projection.py --write`.

classes.title: Plane location — name the plane before binding any concern
classes.statement: Before any concern binds, the symptom names its plane — custody/availability · reach/audience · head/version, plus the truth-vs-projection distinction. A cure applied to the wrong plane is a defect even when locally correct.

classes.title: Anti-self-election — no component crowns what it authored
classes.statement: No component crowns what it authored — except through the guarded legitimate arm: self-candidacy is admissible exactly when `not_retrievable` itself proves a local chain exists. A flat prohibition would forbid a cure the fleet depends on.

classes.title: C2 monotonic authority — never backwards, and name the clock
classes.statement: Selection is decided by declared authority tiers and, within a tier, a NAMED NOTARIZED CLOCK with a deterministic tiebreak — never a conductor-local clock, never arrival order. A move backwards requires proof of forward ordering on that clock; missing ordering evidence refuses the move rather than guessing.

classes.title: Liveness — a legal move exists from every reachable state
classes.statement: From every reachable non-terminal state, at least one AUTOMATED transition is enabled. A human hand (or a deploy) as the only exit is a liveness hole, not an escape hatch.

classes.title: Honest absence — absent, unreachable, refused and unverifiable are distinct answers
classes.statement: Absent, unreachable, refused, and unverifiable are distinct answers, and unreadable / unmeasured never reads as zero or complete. On a full-arc fleet a local `get` miss maps to Unreachable (gossip failed), never Absent.

classes.title: Evidence-not-authority (may-believe) — a claim confers only what the receiver re-derives
classes.statement: A transferred claim confers only what the receiver re-derives — signature over the action AND the entry<->action binding (the clause that closes the swap attack). Evidence that cannot be evaluated confers nothing, in either direction: an unresolvable validator neither hardens nor softens.

classes.title: C6a bounded work — every loop, sweep and retry ladder respects a declared budget
classes.statement: Every loop, sweep, and retry ladder carries a declared budget it provably respects — and a retry policy against an uncancellable call IS a loop even when no `loop` token appears in the diff. New pacing binds the existing drain kernel rather than minting a fourth vocabulary.

classes.title: Idempotent effect — replay against settled state mints nothing and double-applies nothing
classes.statement: Replaying a decision against settled state mints nothing and double-applies nothing — while never licensing lazy acceptance: storage stays an EAGER reconciliation controller (P1). Quiescence is about EFFECT, not effort.

classes.title: Advertise/serve symmetry — what a surface advertises equals what it serves
classes.statement: What a surface advertises equals what it serves — capability, inventory, validator, coverage. A surface that names something it cannot deliver misrepresents itself to every reader.

classes.title: Observability-per-decision — every outcome increments a labeled counter through a typed reason
classes.statement: Every decision outcome increments a labeled counter through a TYPED reason (`label()` from an enum, never a raw string); failures are counted beside successes (a ratio is readable, a bare failure count is not); no label is structurally constant; and every meter names its semantics — census or sample — so a rotating-page gauge is never read as a drain.

classes.title: Identity-lineage continuity — a re-key never silently orphans state
classes.statement: Every reference to an agent resolves through a lineage root stable across key rotation; a re-key never silently orphans state keyed on the old identity — it fails loud or re-anchors.

classes.title: Contract-evolution honesty — an unknown field is rejected or observed, never defaulted
classes.statement: A wire/config/schema contract change is rejected or observed, never defaulted — an unknown or renamed field fails the parse or increments a counter.

classes.title: Externally-imposed backpressure — degrade by a declared, counted policy
classes.statement: Under load it did not schedule, a seam degrades by a DECLARED, COUNTED policy — defer-with-retry-after, shed, or decline, each naming its reason — never by unbounded queueing or OOM.

classes.title: Consent/authorization (may-act) — authority verified structurally at the acting node
classes.statement: Authority to act is verified STRUCTURALLY against a notarized grant AT THE ACTING NODE — never inferred from a carried claim, a self-asserted header, or a substring match.

classes.title: Graduated authority — every scaffold names its successor at the gate
classes.statement: Every authority gate serving a lower social tier is LABELED as a scaffold AND names its successor criterion and graduation trigger on the notarized reach vocabulary (`REACH_LEVELS`) — at the gate site, not only in a doc or backlog.

classes.title: Witnessed residual — the outcome set closes with an arm that is witnessed, never dropped
classes.statement: Every decision point's outcome set closes with a residual arm that is WITNESSED, never dropped: an exception fitting no class is captured with a context capsule sufficient for cross-node RCA (inputs digest, decision state, the clocks/lags/peer-states in play), carried as evidence, delivered to the developer-facing RCA report, and DISPOSITIONED — cure, declared variance, or a new concern class via the calibration ledger's miss-of-canon intake.
